title: 34:8 day of the Lord's vengeance/year of recompenses. The day of vengeance, which falls upon the wicked (D&C 97:26), is also referred to as the day of the Lord (2:12). The implication is that the Lord's vengeance will be brief (day) in comparison to the time of recompense (year) The year of recompenses is the same as the year of my redeemed identified in 63:4 (see commentary there; see also D&C 133:51-52).
author: Tina M. Peterson
